fusions.name: Drover's Prod
fusions.desc: Jabs a goad into the target and drives it back 3 tiles. The jab deals 14 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Head of the Herd
fusions.desc: A broad sweep across a cone 3 tiles ahead deals 26 damage to everything in it, and when it hits, you and your allies strike 20% harder for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Will Not Be Driven
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Unhurried
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
